title: MetaobjectDefinitionInput
description:
The definition of a metaobject type (`metaobject_definitions.<type>`, or one per file in
`metaobject_definitions/`).

$schema.description:
Lets editors validate and autocomplete the file, e.g.
`"../schema/metaobject-definition.schema.json"`.

type.description:
The metaobject type (e.g. `"look"` or `"$app:author"`). Optional inside the
`metaobject_definitions` map (where the map key is the type) and in a single-object
`metaobject_definitions/<type>.json` file (where the file name is the default type);
required in an array file.

name.description: Human-readable name shown in the Shopify admin. Defaults to a humanized form of the type.

description.description: Description of the metaobject type (at most 255 characters).

display_name_key.description: Key of the field used as the display name for entries (`displayNameKey`).

url_handle.description:
The handle of the type's web pages, Shopify's `capabilities.onlineStore.data.urlHandle`:
the entries are served at `/pages/<url_handle>/<handle>`. Defaults to the type.

standard_template.description:
Marks the definition as a Shopify standard metaobject definition (e.g. `product_review`),
populating `standardTemplate` in the Admin API.

field_definitions.description:
The fields of entries of this metaobject type (`fieldDefinitions`). When omitted, fields
are inferred from the entries in `metaobjects`.

MetaobjectAccessInput.description: Access controls of a metaobject definition (`MetaobjectAccess`).

admin.description: Admin API access. Only allowed on app-owned types (`$app:<type>`).

DefinitionAdminAccess.description:
Admin API access level for a metafield or metaobject definition (`MetafieldAdminAccess` /
`MetaobjectAdminAccess`).

DefinitionStorefrontAccess.description:
Storefront API access level for a metafield or metaobject definition
(`MetafieldStorefrontAccess` / `MetaobjectStorefrontAccess`).

MetaobjectCustomerAccountAccess.description:
Customer Account API access level for a metaobject definition
(`MetaobjectCustomerAccountAccess`).

publishable.description: Enables draft/active publish status on entries (`publishable`).

online_store.description: Exposes entries as Online Store web pages (`onlineStore`).

renderable.description: Enables SEO title and description metadata keys (`renderable`).

CapabilityFlag.description: Enables or disables a capability: a boolean (`true` / `false`) or `{"enabled": true}`.

CapabilityEnabled.description: A capability toggle written as an object, matching Shopify's GraphQL input shape.

OnlineStoreCapabilityInput.description:
Online Store capability on a metaobject definition: a boolean, or an object with `url_handle`
and optional `enabled` / `create_redirects` / `data`.

OnlineStoreCapabilityDetail.description: Detailed Online Store capability configuration for a metaobject definition.

enabled.description: Whether Online Store web pages are enabled. Defaults to `true` when this object is given.

url_handle.description: URL handle for the type's web pages (`/pages/<url_handle>/<handle>`).

data.description:
Nested `data` object (`{"url_handle": ..., "create_redirects": ...}`), matching Shopify's
GraphQL input shape.

url_handle.description: URL handle for the type's web pages (`/pages/<url_handle>/<handle>`).

RenderableCapabilityInput.description: Renderable capability on a metaobject definition: a boolean, or an object with SEO key fields.

RenderableCapabilityDetail.description: Detailed Renderable capability configuration for a metaobject definition.

enabled.description: Whether the renderable capability is enabled. Defaults to `true` when this object is given.

meta_title_key.description: Key of the field holding the SEO meta title (`metaTitleKey`).

meta_description_key.description: Key of the field holding the SEO meta description (`metaDescriptionKey`).

data.description:
Nested `data` object (`{"meta_title_key": ..., "meta_description_key": ...}`), matching
Shopify's GraphQL input shape.

meta_title_key.description: Key of the field holding the SEO meta title (`metaTitleKey`).

meta_description_key.description: Key of the field holding the SEO meta description (`metaDescriptionKey`).

MetaobjectFieldDefinitionInput.description: A field definition of a metaobject type (`MetaobjectFieldDefinition`).

key.description: Field key (1–64 characters of letters, digits, `-`, `_`).

name.description: Human-readable name. Defaults to a humanized form of `key`.

description.description: Description of the field (at most 255 characters).

required.description:
Whether entries of this metaobject type must provide a value for this field.
Defaults to `false`.

validations.description:
Validation rules for values of this field (`min`, `max`, `regex`, `choices`,
`metaobject_definition_id`, ...).

MetafieldValidationInput.description:
A validation rule on a metafield definition or metaobject field definition
(`MetafieldDefinitionValidationInput`).

For `metaobject_definition_id` / `metaobject_definition_ids` (or the portable aliases
`metaobject_definition_type` / `metaobject_definition_types`), write portable metaobject type
names (e.g. `"look"`, `"$app:author"`, or `["look", "designer"]`) instead of shop-specific
GIDs; lsf validates them against the store's metaobject definitions and resolves them to the
local shop's definition GIDs in the Admin API.

value.description:
Rule value as a string (Shopify's format, e.g. `"500"`, `"[\"gold\",\"silver\"]"`,
`"look"`), or as a JSON number, array or object.

MetaobjectFieldCapabilitiesInput.description: Capabilities of a metaobject field definition (`MetaobjectFieldDefinitionCapabilities`).

admin_filterable.description: Allows filtering metaobject entries by this field in the admin (`adminFilterable`).
